> Global Chemicals LLC (gcoman.com) is a B2B specialty and industrial chemical
> supplier headquartered in Ghala, Muscat, Oman. The company supplies and exports
> chemicals across the GCC region (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain).
> ISO 9001:2015 certified, JSRS registered, and ICV compliant. Catalog spans
> water treatment, oilfield, food & beverage, laboratory, and specialty chemicals
> (263+ SKUs across 21+ categories). Founded in Muscat; operating
> Sunday–Thursday 08:00–18:00 GST. Contact: info@gcoman.com, +968 93754388.

## Core Identity

- Legal name: Global Chemicals LLC
- Alternate names: GC Oman, GCOMAN, Global Chemicals Middle East
- Domain: https://gcoman.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/global-chemicals-llc
- Headquarters: Office-3, Building 1737, Near Oman LNG, Ghala, Muscat, Oman (PC 111)
- Phone: +968 93754388
- Email: info@gcoman.com
- Hours: Sunday–Thursday, 08:00–18:00 (GST, UTC+4)
- Service area: Oman (Muscat, Sohar, Salalah, Duqm, Rusayl), UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain
- Certifications: ISO 9001:2015, JSRS (Joint Supplier Registration System), ICV (In-Country Value) Compliant
- Business type: B2B wholesale chemical distribution and supply
- Languages: English, Arabic

## Product Categories (21+ categories, 263+ SKUs)

- [Water Treatment Chemicals](https://gcoman.com/products/water-treatment): PAC (Poly Aluminium Chloride), Sodium Hypochlorite, Calcium Hypochlorite, Antiscalants, Coagulants, Flocculants
- [RO Chemicals](https://gcoman.com/products/ro-chemicals): Antiscalants, membrane cleaners, biocides
- [Cooling Water Chemicals](https://gcoman.com/products/cooling-water): Biocides, scale inhibitors, corrosion inhibitors
- [Oilfield & Refinery Chemicals](https://gcoman.com/products/oilfield): Drilling fluids, corrosion inhibitors, production chemicals
- [Corrosion Inhibitors](https://gcoman.com/products/corrosion-inhibitor): ATMP, HEDP, phosphonate-based inhibitors
- [Inorganic Chemicals](https://gcoman.com/products/inorganic): Caustic Soda (NaOH), Hydrochloric Acid, Sulphuric Acid, Sodium Carbonate
- [Chlorinated Chemicals](https://gcoman.com/products/chlorinated): Sodium Hypochlorite (liquid), Calcium Hypochlorite (granular/tablet), TCCA
- [Food & Beverage Grade](https://gcoman.com/products/food-beverage): Food-grade NaOH (E524), food-grade citric acid, food-grade phosphoric acid
- [Industrial Lubricants](https://gcoman.com/products/lubricants): Shell, Mobil, Castrol, GP lubricants and greases
- [Laboratory Chemicals](https://gcoman.com/products/lab-chemicals): AR grade reagents, HPLC solvents, analytical standards
- [Laboratory Equipment](https://gcoman.com/products/lab-equipment): Titration, filtration, measurement instruments
- [Solvents](https://gcoman.com/products/solvents): Acetone, IPA, MEK, toluene, xylene
- [Glycols](https://gcoman.com/products/glycols): MEG, DEG, PEG, propylene glycol
- [Alcohols](https://gcoman.com/products/alcohols): Methanol, ethanol, IPA
- [Ethanolamines](https://gcoman.com/products/ethanolamines): MEA, DEA, TEA
- [Swimming Pool Chemicals](https://gcoman.com/products/swimming-pool): Chlorine tablets, pH adjusters, algaecides
- [Construction Chemicals](https://gcoman.com/products/construction): Admixtures, curing compounds, bonding agents
- [Agro Chemicals](https://gcoman.com/products/agro): Fertilisers, herbicides, adjuvants
- [Additives](https://gcoman.com/products/additives): Defoamers, dispersants, surfactants
- [Calcium Carbonate](https://gcoman.com/products/calcium-carbonate): Ground and precipitated grades
- [Tank Cleaners](https://gcoman.com/products/tank-cleaners): Alkaline and acidic tank cleaning formulations
- [Soap & Detergent](https://gcoman.com/products/soap-detergent): SLES, LABSA, SLS, caustic soda flakes
